text:
- COAP:
- Cyclophosphamide 650 mg/m2 intravenously on days 1 and 8
- Vincristine 1.4 mg/m2 intravenously to a maximum of 2 mg on days 1
and 8
- Cytarabine 50 mg/m2 subcutaneously every 12 hours for 7 days
- Prednisolone 40 mg/m2 orally for 14 days
- Nervous system prophylaxis is not required
- Assess for remission after 3 courses
- Maintenance
- COAP every 6 weeks for 2 years
- Intrathecal treatment as for ALL if there is CNS disease of the
monocytic type
